brief: Octagonal cast-iron bandstand in the middle of the town-square park: a raised white-painted concrete base (with a small red door to the storage room under the stage and round porthole vents), slender dark-green iron columns with lacy scroll brackets, an iron balustrade around the stage, and a flat-spread octagonal roof with a cresting of iron finials rising to a ribbed dome and a flagpole. An iron stair with rails climbs one side; lamp posts and benches around it.
